name: forgeplan-orchestra
description: Unified workflow: Forgeplan artifacts + Orchestra task tracking + Claude Code AI execution. Bidirectional sync, Session Start Protocol with Inbox Pattern, and methodology knowledge base. Requires forgeplan CLI (private app, access via project admin) + Orchestra MCP server. v1.5.0: /sync field-write path fixed — the non-existent set_fields replaced by update_entity, fields passed as {fieldUid, value} with UIDs resolved via list_fields, create_entity moved to the entities[] form (marketplace#208). v1.6.0: read-before-act on task chats, Blocked as a Status (never a phase), checklists from acceptance criteria + a Done-with-open-items report, Artifact backfill from task names with per-row confirmation, pinned workspace UIDs, orphans reported never deleted (marketplace#210). v1.10.0: docs re-verified live against BOTH Orchestra server variants — failure-modes gains the endpoint-split table (agent endpoint: add_relation/approve_action exist, but no create/document layer, hanging message reads, folder:all can drop a project); required checklistUid restored in item examples; create_entity subtask shorthand fixed to entities[]; field-map.sh learns ORCH_MCP_TOKEN; server resolution pinned per project via .claude/orchestra.json (marketplace#282). v1.11.0: server resolution made deterministic and runtime-neutral — NEW scripts/orch-verify.sh resolves the project orchestra.json pin (.agents/ canonical, .claude/ fallback; schema v2: url + tokenEnv + per-runtime names map), handshakes and compares live space/user against the pin; exit 0 = safe to write, 65 = mismatch stop, 66/69/78 = no-config/unreachable/bad-config (marketplace#282). v1.12.0: re-verified live against Orchestra 0.141-beta-0906 — the build that closed folder:all under-reporting, null field-filters, hanging message reads, agent-endpoint creation, move_entity, the document layer, checklist ordering and flat project queries; failure-modes rewritten to keep only what still reproduces (threads unreadable, config write-only, two field shapes) and to add two new ones (delete_entity hangs globally with no error; the daemon can refuse every tool while loading and not recover); orch-verify.sh gains exit 75 NOT_READY; the agent endpoint is documented as a bot identity, not the human (marketplace#282).
